name: Nexus International School (Singapore)
summary: IB World School in Aljunied — frequent shortlist visit for families touring Stamford, SAS, and OFS on the same trip.
body: Nexus Singapore delivers IB programmes with an emphasis on personalised learning from the Aljunied campus. Forum school-hunt threads often park Nexus beside Stamford (Lorong Chuan) and OFS (Pasir Ris) when comparing east/central-east housing. Confirm nursery-through-secondary continuity, fees, and term vacancies before you treat a campus tour as an offer. Dual-career families should confirm after-school care / late-bus options in writing — brochure “flexible days” language is not a pickup plan. Ask how outdoor fair haze plans and class-stall allergen labelling are communicated before volunteer sign-ups lock. Dual-career note: open-house weeks need sibling coverage plans, not dual muted Slack.
waitlistNotes: Rolling interest — confirm seat availability by term and year group.
